name: One-Pot Chicken Parmesan Pasta
description: A one-pot weeknight pasta with bite-sized chicken, a jar of marinara, and penne cooked right in the sauce, finished with melty mozzarella. Kid-friendly, no wine or olives.
recipeIngredient: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
2 tablespoons fresh basil or parsley, chopped
recipeInstructions: Heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and sprinkle with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Cook about 4 minutes until golden and cooked through, then remove to a plate.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the marinara and water. Bring to a strong, steady simmer, then stir in the penne. Cover.
Cook 11-15 minutes, stirring several times so the pasta doesn't stick, until the penne is al dente.
Stir the chicken back in. Add the mozzarella a handful at a time, stirring between additions, then stir in the Parmesan. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Garnish with basil or parsley and serve.
